title: Central Banks Fast-Track CBDCs Amid Bitcoin Surge
content:
TL;DR: Global central banks are accelerating the development of Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) in direct response to the increasing adoption and perceived challenge posed by decentralized digital assets like Bitcoin. This move signals an intensifying effort by state actors to retain monetary control and surveillance capabilities, contrasting sharply with Bitcoin's foundational principles of decentralization, censorship resistance, and individual financial sovereignty.
